text:
Maya: Heads up  final coordination for next week's webinar: topic is 'Serving LLMs reliably: batching, caching, and engineered fallbacks'. Need to lock copy, rehearsal times, and demo scripts today.

Priya: I'm confirmed as speaker for cache routing. Prefer a short rehearsal Tue 2pm PT.

Ethan: I'll cover batching + quantization tradeoffs. Available Tue afternoon or Wed morning.

Kevin: Ops needs to run a 20m smoke during the full rehearsal to validate fallback routing. I need the test vector list.

Lucy: Ops notes for registration -> please include a hidden field for lead_source=webinar and an "interested_in_demo" checkbox so we can auto-tag. SFDC mapping will assign Marketing_Growth.

Maya: Draft public blurb: 'Join Redwood engineers for practical techniques to reduce inference cost and keep services responsive under load. Well demo batching patterns, cache-aware routing, and a live failover sequence.' Add target audience line?

Priya: Add: 'Recommended for platform, infra, and ML engineers owning inference services.' Also add a one-line takeaway: 'Walk away with actionable playbooks to improve latency and availability.'

Alex: Demo plan (short):
- steady traffic to staging endpoint
- at t+45s throttle primary GPU pool to trigger routing
- show switch to quantized model variant and record p50/p95
- if quantized fails, show cpu-fallback and surface a banner
I'll script the traffic generator and a fallback switch demo.

Kevin: Test vectors I'll run: short (1-16 tokens), medium (64 tokens), long (512 tokens). Commands I'll use: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://staging.redwood/internal/infer -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"short prompt","max_tokens":16}'
# repeat for 64 and 512
```
I'll post the full script to the drive.

Lucy: Calendar: proposed rehearsals 
- Dry run (content only) Thu 3pm PT, 30m
- Full run (infra + smoke) Mon 9am PT, 45m
Booked and invite sent.

Maya: Run-of-show (compact):
00:00-00:04 Intro + goals (Maya)
00:04-00:16 Batching & throughput (Ethan)
00:16-00:28 Cache routing + invalidation (Priya)
00:28-00:44 Live demo: routing & failover (Kevin + Alex)
00:44-00:48 CTA + resources (Lucy + Maya)
00:48-01:00 Q&A (all)

Priya: I'll upload one-liner bio + headshot to the shared drive by EOD.

Ethan: I'll drop my slide with key takeaways and a small benchmark chart.

Lucy: SFDC mapping + UTM params utm_campaign=llm-resilience-2026 set. I'll enable lead assignment and create a task template for demo requests.

webinar-bot: Reminder: Slides due 48 hours before event. Uploads: https://drive.redwood/inference/webinars/llm-resilience

Maya: Final asks before EOD:
- Priya/Ethan: bios + slides
- Alex/Kevin: demo scripts and smoke test artifacts in drive
- Lucy: confirm SFDC test record mapping and sample CSV fields

Kevin: Uploaded basic smoke logs and the test script. Full run during Monday rehearsal.

Alex: Demo traffic generator and fallback script uploaded and linked in the invite.

Lucy: SFDC mapping confirmed; sample CSV attached to the drive.

Maya: Perfect  I'll publish the registration copy tomorrow morning and schedule the 10% A/B send for subject lines. Thanks everyone :rocket:
